en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Khalid Al Barqy, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Umar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a man who struck a man with a stick, so his hearing, and his vision, and his tongue, and his intellect, and his private parts ceased to function and his (ability) to copulate went, but he was alive - (a judgement of) six wergilds’.
